name: list_scenarios
description: List all MoM scenarios in the Valkyrie editor directory

dir.description: Custom editor directory (defaults to platform Valkyrie editor path)

name: create_scenario
description: Create a new MoM scenario with default scaffold. Defaults to the Valkyrie editor directory.

dir.description: Custom output directory (defaults to Valkyrie editor dir)

name: load_scenario
description: Load an existing scenario from a directory

name: get_scenario_state
description: Get current scenario state summary

name: validate_scenario
description: Run all validation rules on the current scenario

name: save_scenario
description: Write the current scenario to its folder (INI files, localization, quest.ini) so Valkyrie's editor sees the changes. Edits made with the other tools stay in memory until save_scenario or build_scenario

name: build_scenario
description: Save and build the .valkyrie package with the files Valkyrie's editor "Create Package" writes: <Package>.valkyrie, the <Package>.ini manifest (scenario list entry: quest settings, name, synopsis, description, authors, SHA-256 version) and the cover image. Without outputPath it goes where Valkyrie puts it: <Desktop>/<Package>/. Refuses when validate_scenario reports errors (they break the game in Valkyrie) unless force is true

outputPath.description: A .valkyrie file path, or a folder to create <Package>/ in (default: the Desktop, like Valkyrie)

force.description: Build even when validation reports errors

name: set_quest_config
description: Set quest.ini [Quest] settings. format, type and packs are managed automatically on save.

image.description: Scenario cover image path, relative to the scenario folder

hidden.description: Hide the scenario from the scenario list

name: upsert_event
description: Create or update an event component. IMPORTANT: buttons must be >= highest populated eventN index or Valkyrie will silently drop the excess event references on re-save. A hidden event (display=false) always follows button 1 — branch by listing several targets in event1 ("EventA EventB") with vartests on each target; the first whose tests pass runs. vartests and conditions must not both be set (conditions is ignored). remove also accepts #monsters #boardcomponents #shop #uicomponents #doors #tiles #qitems #tokens

name: upsert_tile
description: Create or update a tile component. Needs side (catalog TileSide) or customImage (image path relative to the scenario folder, optional top/left pixel anchor)

name: upsert_token
description: Create or update a token component. Optional: tokensize (small|medium|huge|massive|Original|<number>), clickeffect=false (decorative, not clickable), customImage (image path; replaces type), type may also be a catalog Monster ID to show that monster

name: upsert_spawn
description: Create or update a spawn component

name: upsert_item
description: Create or update a quest item component

name: upsert_puzzle
description: Create or update a puzzle. A puzzle is an event: start it from a button (event1=PuzzleX), never add=. Fields: class (slide default, code, image, tower), skill ({observation}...), puzzlelevel (code: positions, image: columns, slide/tower: min moves), puzzlealtlevel (code: symbols 1..N, image: rows), puzzlesolution (code: "3 6 1"), image (image puzzle picture), buttons=1 + event1 (runs after solving). The window shows no text: tell the story in the event before it; <name>.button1 labels the finish button

name: upsert_ui
description: Create or update a UI overlay. With vunits=True, size is the height in screen heights and xposition/yposition offset from the screen CENTRE (0,0 = centred) unless halign/valign anchor to an edge. image: built-in (ImageCutsceneBG) or scenario file (img/X.jpg, see generate_artwork). Text: <name>.uitext; buttons=1 + event1 makes it clickable. Show with an event add=, remove later; add buttons last

name: upsert_custom_monster
description: Create or update a custom monster. Fields: base (catalog Monster ID), health, healthperhero, horror, awareness, traits, image, imageplace, activation (MoM: ONE Event name, run every monster phase, e.g. activation=EventBossActivation with randomevents to pick moves/attacks; Descent-style: Activation component names without the prefix), evadeevent, horrorevent (Event names)

name: upsert_mplace
description: Create or update a monster placement (MPlace). Fields: xposition, yposition, master, rotate, tokensize (small|medium|huge|massive|Original|<number>)

name: upsert_activation
description: Create or update a custom monster activation. Fields: minionfirst, masterfirst; text goes in localization keys <name>.ability, <name>.minion, <name>.master, <name>.movebutton, <name>.move

name: delete_component
description: Delete a component and cascade-clean references

name: set_localization
description: Set localization key-value pairs

name: get_map_ascii
description: Describe the board: each tile's area, its doors and where they lead (with a spot for an explore token), every token and the tile it sits on, and an ASCII sketch. Coordinates: x east, y north; a tile hangs east and south from its position, tokens are centred on theirs

name: render_map
description: Render the board as an image exactly as Valkyrie lays it out: tile artwork (from Valkyrie's imported app data, schematic otherwise), tiles labelled A, B, …, tokens numbered and coloured by type (yellow explore, blue search, red interact, green investigators; red ring = not on a tile). Use it to check a layout before playing

outputPath.description: Also save the PNG to this path

name: story_graph
description: Project the scenario's storyline as a graph: what each button, trigger, placed token, item inspection and monster event leads to. format=outline (default) is a condensed text tree: one line per event with its first words, conditions (if ...), effects (variables, +placed/−removed) and END; straight chains stay on one level, decisions indent, repeats point back (↩), and endings and never-reached events are listed. format=mermaid gives a flowchart definition. outputPath (.html) writes a page with the rendered chart and the outline for people. Use it to review or explain the plot, and to find dead ends and loops

root.description: Only the part of the story that follows this component (e.g. EventScream)

outputPath.description: Also write the result: .html (chart + outline page), .mmd/.md (Mermaid) or .txt (outline)

name: artwork_status
description: Check whether a local ComfyUI server with FLUX.2 [klein] 4B is ready for generate_artwork, and how to set up what is missing (comfy-cli install, launch and model downloads)

name: generate_artwork
description: Generate scenario artwork with FLUX.2 [klein] 4B on a local ComfyUI (4 steps, CFG 1, euler) and save it into the scenario folder. Presets: cover/intro 896x896 (quest.ini image, intro cutscene), handout 768x1024 (letters, parchments, photos), scene 1024x768 (pictures during play), monster 768x768 (CustomMonster image), token 512x512 (Token customImage). Describe the subject only; a house style is appended so all pictures match. The first image of a session also loads the model (minutes); later ones take ~30 s. Reference the returned path from ui image=, customImage= etc.

prompt.description: What the picture shows (subject, setting, mood)

outputPath.description: File to write, relative to the loaded scenario folder (e.g. "img/Letter.jpg") or absolute. .jpg keeps packages small; .png is lossless

preset.description: Image size for the intended use (default scene)

seed.description: Fixed seed to reproduce or vary an image (random by default)

steps.description: Sampling steps (default 4 for the distilled model, 20 for base)

style.description: Replaces the default style suffix; "" for none

name: suggest_tile_layout
description: Suggest anchor coordinates for large (7x7) tiles placed edge to edge. For real tiles, prefer place_tile_relative, which also lines up doors and handles small (7x3.5) tiles

name: place_tile_relative
description: Find xposition, yposition and rotation for a new tile so it sits against an existing tile with a door lined up. Returns the best candidates first; each lists the passages (door stretches) connecting the two tiles and any tiles it would overlap

existingTile.description: Name of the existing tile component, e.g. TileHall

direction.description: Side of the existing tile to attach to

side.description: TileSide ID of the new tile, e.g. TileSideLibrary

rotation.description: Force a rotation (0, 90, 180, 270); by default all are tried

name: search_game_content
description: Search game content catalogs (monsters, tiles, audio, etc.)

name: export_bug_report
description: Generate a ZIP bug report bundle with session trace, scenario files, and validation results

outputDir.description: Directory to write the ZIP to (defaults to OS temp dir)
